question: Kailangan pa ba ng bagong fire inspection para sa business permit kung may valid FSIC na galing sa Occupancy Permit?
answer:
Based on the provided sources, if you already have a valid Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (FSIC) issued during the Occupancy Permit stage, you do not need a new fire inspection for a new Business Permit. [S1, S3] However, the sources do not specify if the FSIC should be the same as the one used during the Occupancy Permit or a new one is acceptable. For clarity, it is best to confirm this with the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP).

Wala akoy nakit-an nga impormasyon bahin niini sa Citizens' Charter kung kailangan ba ng bagong fire inspection kung may valid FSIC na galing sa Occupancy Permit na pwede pa rin gamitin para sa business permit. Para sa klaridad, maaayos nga ipagtatanggi sa Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP).
